label: Every generated thing that causes itself has a…, from Anything that comes to be has some distinct…
description: For a generated self-causing entity, instantiate the distinct-cause principle at that same entity to obtain its alternative cause. The self-cause guard is not used; this is one obligation, not a necessity claim about proof-term usage. No axioms are used. This checks mathematical consequence in the selected shared vocabulary, not source fidelity, metaphysical applicability, or the truth of either open causal principle.
